card.name: The letter p starting pump-like words
card.fires_on: The letter p (or P) that begins a word piece after a prefix or space, where the word could continue as pump, pumping or a P-initial acronym. It appears in non-potassium, hyperpnea, overpumping and PEG-J.

modes.label: Pump words
modes.description: A lone p that is likely to continue into pump or pumping.

modes.label: Prefix then p
modes.description: A p after non- or hyper- that starts a medical term such as potassium or pnea.

modes.label: Capital P acronyms
modes.description: A capital P opening a device or drug acronym such as PEG-J, PARI or PPAR.
modes.example: administered using a<< P>>EG-J or naso-jejunal
